text.brief: On March 8, 2000, Bill Clinton told an audience at Johns Hopkins that the Party's effort to control the internet was like trying to nail Jell-O to the wall.
text.record: The House passed permanent normal trade relations 237 to 197 on May 24, 2000, and the Senate followed 83 to 15 ([CRS report RS20691: China and permanent normal trade relations (via EveryCRSReport)](https://www.everycrsreport.com/files/20010717_RS20691_9d7dd0b47ef14e2812416db8a52a844821b20362.pdf); [U.S. Senate roll call vote 106-2-251 on H.R. 4444 (September 19, 2000)](https://www.senate.gov/legislative/LIS/roll_call_votes/vote1062/vote_106_2_00251.htm)). The same act created the Congressional-Executive Commission on China to monitor human rights and the rule of law. The People's Republic joined the World Trade Organization on December 11, 2001 ([WTO: China, member information](https://www.wto.org/english/thewto_e/countries_e/china_e.htm); [WTO: Accessions, China](https://www.wto.org/english/thewto_e/acc_e/a1_chine_e.htm)). Economists later estimated that the surge of imports cost the United States 2.0 to 2.4 million jobs from 1999 to 2011 ([Acemoglu, Autor, Dorn, Hanson and Price, Import Competition and the Great US Employment Sag of the 2000s (MIT copy)](https://economics.mit.edu/sites/default/files/publications/ADH-China-Shock-Published.pdf); [NBER working paper 21906 (same study)](https://www.nber.org/system/files/working_papers/w21906/w21906.pdf)).
text.reading: Accession ended the annual vote that had given Congress leverage each spring, and the relationship changed phase. The Party entered the host's trading system as a guest and began to shape its rules, which is Stratagem 30, while it kept the controls Clinton expected the internet to break.
text.gapText: Architecture Principles. The policy rested on a theory that trade would open the system, and no one set a test for when the theory had failed.
text.fix: State the outcome a trade bargain should produce, and review it on a fixed schedule with the power to change terms.
